name: ui-layouts-spotlight
title: Spotlight Effect
blurb: Radial gradient highlights follow the cursor, illuminating child elements.
description: Provider wrapper that enables cursor-tracking spotlight effects on child items. Three effects: proximity spotlights, hover focus, and local cursor gradients.
use_when: Highlighting cards or features in a grid as the user moves—creates visual interest with proximity-based lighting.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices without a pointer; small viewports where cursor is always centered.
a11y: Listener on window mousemove; passive overlay with no focus impact. Content remains accessible.
